_doc: BLIND 2016 universe — filing dates + payor mix as of FY2016. Data collected blind to 2018+ events for back-test of late-filing and payor-concentration detectors.
_methodology_warning: Late-filing detector cutoff = FYE + 270 days. For Dec-31 FYE obligors, cutoff = 2017-09-27/30. For June-30 FYE, cutoff = 2017-03-27. For Sep-30 FYE, cutoff = 2017-06-27. For May-31 FYE, cutoff = 2017-02-25.

Many EMMA continuing-disclosure-filed-date timestamps are NOT directly retrievable via WebSearch — the EMMA UI is JS-rendered. Instead, I used: (1) audit opinion sign-off date from the audited FS itself as a PROXY for 'audit was completed by date X' (typically EMMA filing within 5-15 days of opinion date); (2) state regulator portals (CT-OHS, MD-HSCRC, IN-DOH, MS Hospital Transparency, FL-flauditor) which timestamp filings; (3) Fitch/Moody's/S&P 2016-2017 surveillance press releases which often cite annual financials being unavailable or recently received.

Payor mix figures are reported at multiple bases (gross patient revenue vs net patient service revenue). I have noted the basis for each. The detector definition (single-payor Medicaid > 65%) needs gross-revenue payor concentration; net-revenue figures understate Medicaid share given contractual write-offs are larger for Medicaid.

CONTAMINATION DISCLOSURE: I deliberately did NOT search for any 2018+ events, distress, downgrades, M&A consummations, or restructuring outcomes for these names while collecting this data. I did encounter (but did not use): (a) Presence Health -> Ascension acquisition closed early 2018; (b) Trinity Mother Frances -> CHRISTUS combined as of May 1, 2016 (this is 2016 in-period — included as fact); (c) ETMC -> Ardent Health sale 2017+; (d) Centegra -> NW Medicine merger 2018; (e) NYU Winthrop -> NYU Langone full integration Jan 2017 (in-period for some metrics).

Where the audit-completion date is shown but EMMA submission date is unknown, I report the opinion date with a _notes annotation. EMMA submissions typically follow opinion dates by 0-14 days for active issuers.

Mary Washington Healthcare, South Shore Hospital, Carson Tahoe, Central Washington, Erlanger, Owensboro, Eisenhower, Tufts MC, Centegra, Tallahassee Memorial, NYU Winthrop, CHLA, Baxter Regional, Hospital for Special Care, Jackson, Milford Regional, Memorial North Conway, Nanticoke, ETMC, Oaklawn, Yavapai, Palmetto, Houston County HCA were NOT directly retrievable as 2016-vintage audited FS PDFs via the methods available. Confidence is therefore LOW or MEDIUM for these on filing date, and payor mix is inferred from contemporaneous Fitch/Moody's/S&P 2016 surveillance reports.

_data_collection_notes: Best sources discovered: (1) state regulator portals — MD HSCRC, IN DOH, MS Hospital Transparency, CT OHS, FL flauditor have direct PDF AFS archives by fiscal year; (2) Fitch/Moody's/S&P 2016 rating action press releases on BusinessWire give point-in-time payor mix metrics with citations; (3) CHIA MA Hospital Profiles Compendium 2016 provides public-payer percentages for all MA acute hospitals.

Methods that failed: (1) general WebSearch for EMMA-hosted audits — the EMMA UI requires JS rendering, so direct timestamp retrieval impossible without browser automation; (2) WebFetch on scanned/image PDFs (e.g., Memorial Gulfport 2016) — text layer absent; (3) WebFetch on JSON-rendered EMMA pages.
If recompute is desired: download EMMA continuing disclosure XML via msrb.org/EMMA-API for each obligor's CUSIP — this is the only source for exact filing timestamps.
